docs: Timeline content: the heading, a description and the steps of a process or a history, each with the date or the stage, a title and a line. One object is valid in every timeline layout (one column, two or four columns).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

date.docs: the date or the stage as it is shown (Week 1, 2024)

text.docs: one line about the step; empty: none
